newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta Freeport business rose in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Malta Freeport business rose in 1996.

text.p: Malta Freeport in 1996 handled 593,013 containers, an increase of 22,013 over the previous year, company chairman Marin Hili said on Tuesday.
The increase was achieved despite stiff competition from the freeport of Gioia Tauro on the southern tip of Italy.
Hili said Malta Freeport was aiming to increase its activity to 700,000 containers this year and one million by 2000.

Malta Freeport said on Friday that Hyundai Merchant Marine of South Korea had selected Malta as its Mediterranean hub and would be sending some 50,000 containers to Malta Freeport every year for onward shipment by feeder services.
Malta Freeport would be the central link in a Hyundai service linking Singapore to Rotterdam as from February 24, 1997.
Malta Freeport is due to start using a second terminal later this year.
